notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (connox.com) has no Claude/bot-specific disallow, only a few path exclusions (customer-area, watch-list, etc.) - tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl_cffi, impersonate=chrome120) worked for all pages, no blocks encountered at any tier. Site already serves English locale at connox.com (html lang=en, hreflang alternates to connox.de/.at/.fr/.ch/.nl) so no translation of source text was needed beyond a couple of literal-translation cleanups noted below. TREE: built the full category tree from the union of the site's mega-menu (extracted and deduped ~348 unique category/tag links spanning Home Decor, Furniture, Lighting, Serve, Household, Outdoor, Kids, Pet Supplies, Bathroom Decor, and every room-based menu e.g. Living Room/Bedroom/Dining Room - all of which repeat the same canonical category URLs) plus each hub category's own page content, then cross-checked ambiguous leaf pages' <title>/meta description for true product meaning. Playwright (headless chromium) was used to render each candidate category/hub URL and read the true rendered 'N Items' header text (product listing is a client-side React component with no product count in the raw SSR HTML/JSON, so tier (a) alone could not see quantities - escalated to tier (b) Playwright per STEP1 rule1, no CAPTCHA/bot-wall encountered). H1 and canonical URL were confirmed to match the requested node on every recorded leaf. QTY: qty = the exact 'NNN Items' text rendered on each category's own listing page (Playwright DOM read), no estimation/aggregation. Hub/landing pages with no #products React section (Home Textiles, Kitchen Linen, Outdoor Textiles, Children's Room Textiles, Storage & Organization, Organisation, Laundry, Table textiles) are grouping rows only (qty=null) per rule - their own URL is not recorded when valid subcategories exist. 'Storage & Organization' (Home Decor menu) and 'Organisation' (Household menu) are two separate nav entry points to an overlapping set of leaf categories (different CategoryIds, same children); leaves were deduped by URL and merged once under a single 'Storage & Organization' group to avoid duplicate records. 'Table textiles' hub duplicates already-recorded Home Textiles leaves (Table Cloths, Table Runner, Napkins) plus Kitchen&Dining-only items, so it was not created as a second group (would only produce duplicate rows). EXCLUDED (checked and ruled out): Storage furniture/Bedroom furniture/Entryway furniture/Shelves/Chests of drawers/Sideboards/TV furniture/Cabinets/Display cases/Containers/Bottle racks/Clothes ladders/Shoe Storage - all explicitly nested under the site's Furniture mega-menu category (already covered by validated Furniture.xlsx, out of scope here); Bookends, Money Boxes, Pinboards, Calendars, Key fob, Door Stoppers, Office accessories, Cosmetic tissue boxes, Trash cans/Pedal bins, Wastebaskets, Kitchen roll holder, Utensil holder - decorative/office/waste-disposal items not primarily storage per storage.md; Bags and Toiletry bag & Cosmetic bags - personal-carrying/fashion bags excluded per storage.md Sec6 boundary example; kitchenware/shelves.html ('Shelves') confirmed via meta description to be decorative display etageres for fruit/jewelry/decor, not storage; Mattresses/Folding Mattresses - bedding-adjacent but not textile per textile.md (sleep-surface product, Furniture-adjacent, not covered by this task); Changing mats & changing bags (baby gear, neither category); Napkin holder/Napkin rings/Glass coasters/Trays/Decorative Bowls/Fruit Bowls (Kitchen&Dining/Decorative accessories, not Textile/Storage); Draining rack, Rinse organizer, Clothes Horses, Ironing boards (cleaning/laundry equipment, not storage of belongings). BORDERLINE (kept, flagged): Doormats (rules explicitly list Doormats under Rugs&Floor Textiles but material on this site is mixed coir/rubber/textile - MEDIUM); Hot-Water Bottles (site files under home-textiles URL and the products are knit-covered/fabric hot water bottles & heat pads, but primary object is not textile - LOW); Coat hanger, Cable organisation, Key racks & key boxes (mistranslated 'Keyboards' node - meta description confirms 'key boards and key boxes' i.e. key racks), Cutlery Trays, Magazine holder, Wood Storage, Bath shelves & Shower shelves - all confirmed via meta description/consistent placement across 2-3 separate 'Storage & Organization'/'Organisation' nav hubs to be genuine storage/organizer products even though not verbatim in the rule examples - MEDIUM (LOW for Coat hanger, since individual clothes hangers are a weaker fit than organizer systems).
